description: Portal Bencana is Malaysia's national disaster information portal, run by the National Disaster Control Centre of the National Disaster Management Agency (NADMA). The portal read on 2026-09-28 gathers in one place the feeds of technical agencies: weather warnings for earthquakes and tsunamis, strong winds and rough seas, thunderstorms, continuous heavy rain and tropical cyclones; flood and drought information; the air pollution index; road closures; tides and high tide events; and the social welfare department's disaster information with evacuation centres, together with media statements and links to the armed forces, civil defence, fire and rescue and police. Coverage is Malaysia. Access is free on the web; the site states that NDCC reserves all rights. Caveats: several sections embed other agencies' pages, which the cloud session showed as missing frames, so formats and archives were not read, and the portal is in Malay. It supports emergency response studies, such as linking flood warnings, road closures and open evacuation centres during monsoon floods. No related Malaysian disaster portal record is catalogued.
